title: Qing Lantern Orphanage / Luoyang
summary: Restricted institutional record concerning the Qing Lantern Orphanage in Luoyang. The archive contains references to its connection with Saigyou Norisuke's wider security network.
body:
SUBJECT

QING LANTERN ORPHANAGE

The Qing Lantern Orphanage operated in Luoyang, Monument.

Archive references indicate that children from the institution were occasionally transferred into private security, apprenticeship and protective-service arrangements. The exact nature of those arrangements varies by source.

Saigyou Norisuke's wider security network appears in records concerning several such transfers.

Kenji is documented as having spent his childhood at the institution.
